# Haitech Medical Solutions

> Haitech Medical Solutions Private Limited is a Mumbai-based supplier of premium dental and medical equipment in India. It is the authorized supplier of six specialist brands: Admetec (dental loupes and LED headlights), Almadent (dental chairs and units), Medesy (surgical instruments), Salli (ergonomic saddle chairs), Strauss (diamond burs) and Bondent (endodontics, CBCT imaging and implant systems). Customers can request a single quote across all six brands.

Contact: sales@haitech-group.com | +91 8291939355
Address: Office No. 912, 9th Floor, Kohinoor Compound, Swastik Disa Corporate Park, Lal Bahadur Shastri Marg, Nityanand Nagar, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400086, India
Site language and region: English (India). Prices are in INR and include GST where shown.

## Product categories
- [Dental loupes](https://medical.haitech-group.com/dental-loupes): Admetec Galilean (2.5x-3.2x), prismatic, Ergo (3.0x-10x) and Ergo V loupes, plus LED headlights and frames.
- [Dental chairs](https://medical.haitech-group.com/dental-chairs): Almadent AY-3000, AY-6000 and AY-8000 dental chairs and units.
- [Saddle chairs](https://medical.haitech-group.com/saddle-chairs): Salli ergonomic saddle chairs for dentists and clinicians.
- [Endodontics](https://medical.haitech-group.com/endodontics): Bondent rotary, reciprocating and hand files, endo motors, apex locators, obturation and irrigation devices.
- [CBCT imaging](https://medical.haitech-group.com/cbct): Bondent CBCT 1030 Pro, 1030 Pro 2-in-1 and 1020MS.
